input: Use the Macaroni Kid editions near Asheville (Hendersonville, Brevard, Waynesville, Johnson City, Greenville SC and others) and their summer camp guides to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 Adventure Camps and Kolo Bike Park camps include climbing, ziplining and mountain biking.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 offerings include general and themed summer camps; 2027 information is scheduled for February 1.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: Movers and Shakers summer day camp has weekly themes and movement activities; 2026 confirmed.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Theatre
candidates.note: Tanglewood summer camps for ages 4–18 include theatre skills and musical productions.

candidates.name: Asheville Junior Theater
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps include musical theatre and improv for children and teens.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: 2026 camps for ages 4–18 include rock, jazz, strings, ukulele, voice and music production.

candidates.name: D-BAT Asheville
candidates.note: Baseball and softball summer camps and skill clinics for young players.

candidates.name: Full Moon Equestrian
candidates.note: June 2025 day camp for ages 6+ included riding, horse care, groundwork and crafts.

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 weekly STEM camps at Biltmore Park and UNC Asheville include coding, engineering and math.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Camps offer weeklong outdoor exploration for rising kindergarten through eighth grade.

candidates.name: OSEGA Gymnastics
candidates.note: Summer camps combine gymnastics, ninja obstacles and crafts; full-day ages 5–12 and half-day ages 3–4.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Runs regional summer day camps, including Explorer Camp, and overnight YMCA Camp Watia near Bryson City.
